min_reliable_bbox_height_px.description: minimum bbox height for a reliable distance estimate

max_ingest_range_m.description: Max distance (m) at which a sign observation is accepted; farther readings are refused.

association_dist_m.description: max distance between two observations of the same sign

min_hits.description: confirming observations before a sign is published

robot_corridor_flip_ticks.description: ticks the robot's own corridor must settle before discovery accepts the change

max_pillar_aspect.description: Widest box (width/height) still accepted as a pillar; 0.0 disables the aspect gate.

frame_edge_tolerance_px.description: A box clipped at a frame edge is exempt from the aspect test; tolerance in px. 0 disables.

range_scale.description: Empirical multiplier on the pinhole range; valid only paired with the camera time alignment.

lidar_range_fusion.description: Take the sign's range from the LIDAR ray at the camera's bearing; valid only paired with the cluster gate.

vision_latency_s.description: Camera capture-to-consumption lag (s), used only when a detection carries no capture stamp.

snap_to_lattice_m.description: Snap a fixed observation to the corridor lattice; 0.0 disables.

lidar_range_fusion_cluster.description: Gate the LIDAR range fusion on a free-standing pillar-width cluster agreeing with the pinhole; false is the harmful ungated form.

lidar_range_fusion_agreement.description: Fractional range disagreement (fraction of the pinhole estimate) above which the LIDAR cluster is rejected and the pinhole range stands.

max_signs_per_section.description: Refuse to publish a sign into a section already holding this many; 0 disables the cap.

colour_pool_radius_m.description: pool colour votes across fragments of one pillar within this radius (0 = off)

barrier_belief_min_sightings.description: Magenta sightings that must agree on a location before it is believed to be the parking barrier; 0 disables.

barrier_merge_radius_m.description: Two magenta sightings within this distance (m) are treated as the same barrier.

barrier_span_along_wall.description: Treat the believed parking lot as its 0.45 m span along the wall rather than a point; extends suppression along the wall only.

barrier_suppression_radius_m.description: A RED detection within this distance (m) of a believed barrier is dropped instead of seeded as a pillar.
